zg361_cl_m319_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case

    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 4
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_counteroffer_count value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_vacancy_id value = var:zg361_transfer_cl_vacancy }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_target_manager value = var:zg361_transfer_cl_receiver }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_counteroffer_limit value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_release_deadline_days value = 30 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_deadline_days value = 90 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_released_on_time value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_fulfilled value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_manager_talent_delta value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_released_on_time value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_fulfilled value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_pending value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m319_manager_talent_delta }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 319 market.counteroffer_then_release"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m319_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 319 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_object_route = 1 }
            zg361_career_hc_settle_cl_transfer_effect = yes
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_transfer_cl_applied = 1 }
                zg361_cl_m312_hire_once_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_release_or_promise_checked value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_manager_talent_delta value = -20 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
            }
            else = {
                # Invalid receiver/war/HC joins reclaim the reserved seat and
                # close as policy debt without any scripted liege mutation.
                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 6 MECHANISM = 319 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_resolved value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_state value = 4 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_debt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_mobility_settlement_failed value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_release_or_promise_checked value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_manager_talent_delta value = -20 }
            }
            if = {

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {

                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            } }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 319 release_obligation obligation"
    }

                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
            }
            NOT = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_subject_response }
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 2
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_subject_response value = scope:zg361_cl_subject_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_subject_response_applied value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: assessed subject answered 319 once"
    }
}
